papers.title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
papers.abstract_snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. papers.reason: 针对“加入触觉输入后增益不稳定、visuo-tactile VLA 实际很少依赖触觉”这一瓶颈，提出 TacInno，让 VLA 显式学习接触动力学而非仅拟合视觉-动作映射。可复用点：其触觉表征与训练目标可直接移植到现有触觉 VLA 的融合模块，解决触觉输入被忽略的问题。

papers.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
papers.abstract_snippet: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. papers.reason: 提出细粒度第一人称视频描述格式与再标注管线，缓解 MLLM 漏检短动作、时序错乱和误读佩戴者运动的问题。可作为真实机器人第一人称数据的自动标注工具，但论文本身不含机器人操作实验。
